description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M). Single change: qk shape (NAP=4, tph=256) -> (NAP=5, tph=128). Param-matched: 6*256*16*128 = 6*128*32*128 = 3.15M/L. Middle ground in qk wide-vs-deep axis (vs exp699 wide NAP=3,tph=512 and exp700 deep NAP=6,tph=64, both lost). 32 rows x 128 tables. Tests if NAP=5 beats NAP=4 sweet spot. Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M (NAP=4,tph=256), exp699=lost at NAP=3, exp700=lost at NAP=6.
